info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Cross-Channel Session Dialogue Management API
info.description: This API facilitates the management of cross-channel dialogue sessions within the banking ecosystem. By enabling the PATCH method, it allows clients to update the state and attributes of existing session dialogues, thus ensuring seamless customer interactions across various channels. Typical consumers include banking application developers and customer experience teams looking to enhance user engagement. With informative responses, this API aims to improve session continuity and responsiveness in customer service applications.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the properties of a specific session dialogue identified by its resource ID. Use this operation to modify session dialogue attributes or settings as required.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the session dialogue identified by RES-100045. It must adhere to the specified schema and provide the necessary data for the update operation.
